item.title: About
item.description:
I’m currently a Solution Architect at Kainos where I build new products in the Workday ecosystem.

Formerly of The National Lottery Heritage Fund, HM Land Registry and Microtest.

I graduated from the Open University in 2020 with a BSc. (Hons) in Computing and IT (Software), which I studied for alongside my day job.

With over ten years of industry experience, I have broad knowledge across a number of programming languages and frameworks which I have used to build customer-facing web applications; RESTful APIs; automated testing suites; CI/CD pipelines; and complex integrations between existing systems. I’ve done this in both the public and private sectors for mission critical projects used by thousands of end users.
